messages:
naomi: Heads up from recruiting  bulk importer mis-mapped interviewer roles after last night's ATS schema change. Several panel invites show 'observer' instead of 'interviewer'.
lucy: Oh no. Which field shifted? We updated the ATS export header to include 'region' which might've pushed columns.
ben: confirmed: CSV column order changed; importer was doing positional mapping not header-based. we have ~34 assignments affected, 8 active interviews.
janet: sample query: SELECT i.id, i.role, ai.raw_csv FROM interviewer_assignments i JOIN applicant_imports ai ON ai.id = i.import_id WHERE ai.import_ts >= '2024-07-11T02:00:00Z' AND i.role='observer' AND ai.source='bulk_csv';
aj: importer code uses index-based map for legacy reasons to keep fast parsing. we attempted to be tolerant of new optional columns but apparently not for inserted region col.
sasha: impact: some interviewers didn't get panel prep emails and were not scheduled as required contributors. recruiter flagged a mismatched panel where lead interviewer was marked observer.
naomi: immediate mitigation: 1) pause the importer job, 2) re-run mapping using header names to detect shifted columns, 3) backfill corrected roles and re-send invites for impacted interviews only.
lucy: pausing job now.
ben: I can write a quick header-based remapper that reconciles positional vs header mapping and outputs a diff CSV for review.
janet: please include import_id and row_number in the diff so we can target backfills.
ben: will do. quick patch: parse headers, compute column index shifts, map roles by header name then produce changeset. running on affected file now.
recruitbot: automated notice: bulk_import_job #4821 paused by user lucy at 2024-07-11T05:12:10Z. 34 rows flagged for review.
aj: long-term we should enforce header-based mapping and add a preflight check that fails imports when unexpected headers are present. raise a migration plan to move to named mapping.
sasha: agree. also add an alert when role-assignment rates diverge from historical baseline (e.g., observer assignments > 2% of total).
naomi: comms: recruiters prefer we auto-correct interviewer roles for active interviews and only notify affected interviewers. please avoid resending invites to whole panels.
ben: backfill script ready. applying to 8 active interviews first, then batch rest. diff CSV attached to internal ticket HR-IMP-333.
janet: applied to the 8 active ones; verified lead interviewer now has correct role and got prep emails.
lucy: import pipeline resumed after adding header-check preflight. setting a 24hr hold before auto-accepting new header shapes.
aj: will open RFC to deprecate positional import by end of quarter. includes migration plan and small client library change for partners.
naomi: good work all. follow-up: add test case for sample shifted columns and update runbook for bulk-import incidents. closing loop when RFC merged. :white_check_mark:
